ann.t: Outcome of Board Meeting — HDFC Bank Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
Outcome of Board Meeting — HDFC Bank Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended Jun 30, 2026.
Outcome of Board Meeting — HDFC Bank Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended March 31, 2026.
Resignation of Independent director — HDFC BANK LIMITED has informed the Exchange about Resignation of Independent director.
Resignation — HDFC Bank Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Resignation of Mr Atanu Chakraborty  as Chairman of the company w.e.f. March 18, 2026.

Press Release — HDFC Bank Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated January 17, 2026, titled FINANCIAL RESULTS (INDIAN GAAP) FOR THE QUARTER AND NINE MONTHS ENDED DECEMBER 31, 2025 .
Outcome of Board Meeting — HDFC Bank Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended December 31, 2025.

News Verification — The Exchange has sought clarification from HDFC Bank Limited with respect to recent news item captioned RBI imposes monetary penalty on HDFC Bank for lapses in KYC, interest rate and outsourcing compliance.  The response from the Company is attached.
